caption:
You're still not good enough. You keep polishing yourself to be accepted — but what if the altar was never yours to shape? (Galatians 3:14 devotional)

God commanded an altar of uncut stones — "wield no tool on them" — so the blessing would rest on His gift, never your craftsmanship. He sets human merit at zero, yet the story ends at a table, eating and rejoicing in His presence. The blessing of Abraham reaches you in Christ as pure gift, bought at His cost, not your skill.
